test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between A and C. Q sits to the immediate left of C. No one sits to the right of B. Only two people sit between B and Q. D sits to the immediate right of R. How many people sit between P and D?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) Only three people sit between A and C.

2) Q sits to the immediate left of C.

3) No one sits to the right of B.

4) Only two people sit between B and Q.

5) D sits to the immediate right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30088ecf6de9eb0c139c8ef990f58fa557383fe3985b030313834471a06f5a44.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8063f582db39a38567d7cdcaec0b5dba440304aa9ff2ebd99fd66a020c3b18eb.png] 

So, Two people sit between P and D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
